key.name: notch
key.description: Show notifications, live activities and volume or brightness changes in a pill at the top centre of the screen. Turning it off restores the standard banners and on-screen display. The notification history stays in the calendar menu.

key.name: notch-notifications
key.description: Show notification banners in the notch instead of the standard banner.

key.name: notch-live-activities
key.description: Show what is happening now, such as the playing song, in the notch.

key.name: notch-osd
key.description: Show volume and brightness changes in the notch instead of the standard on-screen display.

key.name: notch-timeout
key.description: How long a notification stays in the notch. Hovering keeps it open and urgent ones stay until dismissed.
